When you look good, you're more likely to feel good about yourself, which can boost your confidence and self-esteem. 4. **Self-perception theory**: This theory suggests that people's self-perceptions are influenced by their behavior and appearance. When you dress professionally, you may start to see yourself as more confident and capable, which can create a self-fulfilling prophecy. Overall, it's great that you've found a way to boost your confidence through dressing professionally!
